fix: Let the pack carry test-level entries (package plus -run pattern) alongside whole packages, detect the tree-reading tests by name with the same AST rule, move the 13 records into the pack as test-level entries, and empty the table.
source: console, 2026-09-30, architecture review of the lane-ship size-ratchet fix
summary: TestPackages_HoldEveryTestThatReadsTheWholeTree (go/internal/repocontract) records 13 packages outside the fixed pack: cmd/evolve, bridge, changedpkgs, core, cycleoutcome, inboxmover, inboxmover/lifecycle, phaseobserver, phases/audit, phases/runner, phases/ship, reachabilityprobe, subagent. Each holds seam or single-writer tests (e.g. TestVerdictEngine_OneConstructionSite, TestPhaseTimings_SingleWriter) that scan the whole module, so a lane touching neither the package nor an importer can break one and only main's CI finds out. Running each whole package at every ship is too slow.
title: Run the seam and single-writer tests that read the whole tree before main, by test name, instead of recording 13 packages outside the pack
